settings.slippageToleranceTooltip: Due to market volatility, prices may change before completion. This setting ensures you receive at least your minimum amount.
settings.slippageDescription: Maximum acceptable price change. Transaction will fail if the price moves unfavorably beyond this amount.
settings.twapTooltip: Relevant for large volume swaps only. Best Price offers optimum price for the order. Best Time prioritizes swap execution time (whenever possible). Custom lets you configure the number of mini-swaps the swap should be broken into and time between each mini-swap.
settings.numberOfSubSwapsDescription: How many sub-swaps to split your trade into. More trades = better price, longer execution.
settings.timeBetweenSubSwapsDescription: Delay between each sub-swap. Longer intervals allow pools to rebalance for better pricing.

riskLevel.title: Provider Risk Levels
riskLevel.description: These levels show how providers handle swaps and transaction checks.
riskLevel.excellentInfo: Direct on-chain execution. No provider checks or freezes. Automatic refunds if swap fails.
riskLevel.goodInfo: Provider checks transactions automatically before completion. If issues are detected, the swap is rejected and funds are refunded.
riskLevel.fairInfo: Additional verification may be required for some transactions. If issues are detected, funds are usually refunded automatically.
